detail: BanknoteNews entry for the Democratic Republic of the Congo's new 100-franc note (B320a) describes the note as having a "new printer imprint (GIESECKE & DEVRIENT MUNICH)". No Printer: field; the fact rests on the printer imprint carried on the note itself. Circulating note, not a commemorative.
source_title: Congo Democratic Republic new 100-franc note (B320a) confirmed — BanknoteNews

detail: BanknoteNews entry for Lesotho's new note family (B227a - B231a), introduced 23.12.2021, gives "Printer: (De La Rue)" for each of the five denominations in the family - i.e. the whole circulating series, not a single note.
source_title: Lesotho new note family (B227a – B231a) confirmed introduced on 23.12.2021 — BanknoteNews

detail: BanknoteNews entry for Somalia's new 2,000-shilling note (B318a) gives "Printer: (Sudan Currency Printing Press)". Circulating note. Somalia's notes are therefore printed at Sudan's state currency printing works, not domestically.
BanknoteNews entry for Tajikistan's new commemorative 100-somoni note (B222a), introduced 30.10.2025, gives "Printer: (Giesecke & Devrient)". This is a commemorative note, not the circulating series.
source_title: Tajikistan new commemorative 100-somoni note (B222a) confirmed introduced 30.10.2025 — BanknoteNews

detail: BanknoteNews entry for Laos's new 100,000-kip note (B524a) gives "Printer: (Goznak)". Circulating note - the top denomination of the kip series. Goznak is the Russian state currency works.

entity: Security Printing Works, Wazi (Central Bank of Myanmar)
detail: BanknoteNews entry for Myanmar's new 20,000-kyat note (B120a), introduced 31.07.2023, gives "Printer: SECURITY PRINTING WAZI CBM" - the Central Bank of Myanmar's own security printing works at Wazi. This is a commemorative note, not the circulating series.
source_title: Myanmar new 20,000-kyat commemorative note (B120a) confirmed introduced on 31.07.2023 — BanknoteNews

detail: BanknoteNews entry for Bhutan's new commemorative 1,000-ngultrum note (B227a) gives "Printer: (De La Rue)". Commemorative note in the series marking the Fourth King's 70th birth anniversary, not the ordinary circulating series.
source_title: Bhutan new commemorative 1,000-ngultrum note (B227a) confirmed — BanknoteNews

detail: BanknoteNews entry for the Macau 1,000-pataca note (B242a) issued by Bank of China Macau gives "Printer: (Hong Kong Note Printing Limited)". Circulating note, top denomination of the Bank of China Macau series; Macau's other note-issuing bank is BNU, whose printer is not stated in this entry.

BanknoteNews entry for Oman's new 1-rial commemorative note (B245a), introduced 11.01.2026, gives "Printer: (Giesecke+Devrient)". Oman's first polymer note; a commemorative, not the circulating series.
source_title: Oman new 1-rial commemorative note (B245a) reported for introduction 11.01.2026 — BanknoteNews

detail: BanknoteNews entry for Syria's new 500-pound note (B642a) gives "Printer: (Goznak)". Circulating note in the redenominated series that dropped two zeros from the Syrian pound; Goznak is the Russian state currency works.

BanknoteNews entry for the Cayman Islands 70-dollar QEII Platinum Jubilee note (B227a), introduced 12.10.2023, gives "Printer: DE LA RUE". Commemorative note issued by the Cayman Islands Monetary Authority, not the circulating series.
source_title: Cayman Islands new 70-dollar QEII Platinum Jubilee commemorative note (B227a) confirmed introduced on 12.10.2023 — BanknoteNews

detail: BanknoteNews entry for Lebanon's new 100,000-pound note (B549a), dated 03.07.2023 and introduced 01.12.2023, gives "Printer: (Crane)". Circulating note, the top denomination of the Lebanese pound series.
source_title: Lebanon new 100,000-pound note (B549a) confirmed introduced 01.12.2023 — BanknoteNews

detail: BanknoteNews entry for the Comoros new 10,000-franc note (B312a), reportedly introduced 06.01.2026, gives "Printer: (Banque de France)". Circulating note, top denomination; the Comorian franc is printed at the French central bank's own works.
source_title: Comoros new 10,000-franc note (B312a) reportedly introduced 06.01.2026 — BanknoteNews
